# Exported functions that nothing in this module calls, recorded as a backlog.
#
# This file exists so TestNoDeadExportedFunctions can have teeth today. Everything listed here
# predates the check and is NOT approved — it is debt, held still. The check fails if a NEW dead
# exported function appears, and equally if an entry here stops being dead, so the list cannot
# grow silently and cannot rot.
#
# Before deleting one, read it. Some are surplus. Others are a feature that was written and never
# wired, where the right fix is to wire it — GetPostIdsOlderThan, BulkArchivePosts and friends
# look like a retention pass that was never called, and deleting those would erase the evidence
# of a gap rather than close it.
#
# One name per line. Names, not paths, so a file move is not a false failure.
